content: WebGL fullscreen shader perf: cap pixel ratio at 2 via Math.min(devicePixelRatio, 2) — on 3x DPR screens this cuts fragment workload by 56% with imperceptible visual difference. Fragment shaders dominate cost (pixel count). Dynamic resolution scaling: render to smaller WebGLRenderTarget then upscale. Pause render loop via Page Visibility API when tab hidden. prefers-reduced-motion: stop animation or freeze to final state. For static scenes set matrixAutoUpdate=false. antialias:false for fullscreen shaders (no edges to smooth).
